source_title: Coronary Heart Disease - What Is Coronary Heart Disease? | NHLBI, NIH
source_supported_en: Coronary heart disease happens when plaque narrows the heart's arteries and reduces the flow of oxygen-rich blood to the heart muscle.

source_title: Coronary Heart Disease - What Is Coronary Heart Disease? | NHLBI, NIH
source_supported_en: For many people coronary heart disease can be prevented or slowed with a heart-healthy lifestyle and medicines.

source_title: Coronary Heart Disease - Symptoms | NHLBI, NIH
source_supported_en: Coronary heart disease may stay silent until it causes a heart attack or another complication.

source_title: Coronary Heart Disease - Symptoms | NHLBI, NIH
source_supported_en: As plaque builds up you may notice chest pain shortness of breath or neck pain during activity and the symptoms may improve with rest.

source_title: Coronary Heart Disease - What Is Coronary Heart Disease? | NHLBI, NIH
source_supported_en: Doctors diagnose coronary heart disease using symptoms medical and family history risk factors and heart tests.

source_title: Coronary Heart Disease - Risk Factors | NHLBI, NIH
source_supported_en: Smoking high blood pressure high LDL cholesterol diabetes obesity and poor sleep can all raise the risk of coronary heart disease.

source_title: Coronary Heart Disease - Symptoms | NHLBI, NIH
source_supported_en: Heart attack pain may feel like pressure squeezing tightness or burning and it can spread to the shoulders arms neck jaw or back.

source_title: Coronary Heart Disease - Symptoms | NHLBI, NIH
source_supported_en: Cold sweats dizziness nausea shortness of breath and weakness can also happen during a heart attack.

source_title: Coronary Heart Disease - Symptoms | NHLBI, NIH
source_supported_en: Women are less likely than men to report classic chest pain during a heart attack and may instead notice dizziness extreme tiredness nausea or stomach pain.

source_title: Coronary Heart Disease - Symptoms | NHLBI, NIH
source_supported_en: If you cannot tell whether chest pain is a heart attack call 9-1-1 right away.

source_title: Heart Failure - Symptoms | NHLBI, NIH
source_supported_en: Heart failure symptoms usually get worse as the heart grows weaker.

source_title: Heart Failure - Symptoms | NHLBI, NIH
source_supported_en: Shortness of breath during routine tasks such as climbing stairs may be one of the first signs of heart failure.

source_title: Heart Failure - Symptoms | NHLBI, NIH
source_supported_en: Left-sided heart failure can cause trouble breathing cough fatigue weakness and difficulty lying flat to sleep.

source_title: Heart Failure - Symptoms | NHLBI, NIH
source_supported_en: Right-sided heart failure may lead to swelling in the feet legs or abdomen along with nausea loss of appetite frequent urination or weight gain.

source_title: Heart Failure - Symptoms | NHLBI, NIH
source_supported_en: Heart failure can damage the kidneys or liver and can cause fluid to build up in or around the lungs.

source_title: Arrhythmias - What Is an Arrhythmia? | NHLBI, NIH
source_supported_en: An arrhythmia is a problem with the rate or rhythm of the heartbeat so the heart may beat too fast too slow or irregularly.

source_title: Arrhythmias - What Is an Arrhythmia? | NHLBI, NIH
source_supported_en: A frequent irregular rhythm may reduce blood flow and leave you dizzy faint or otherwise unwell.

source_title: Arrhythmias - What Is an Arrhythmia? | NHLBI, NIH
source_supported_en: Untreated arrhythmias can damage the heart brain or other organs and may lead to stroke heart failure or cardiac arrest.

source_title: Arrhythmias - Treatment | NHLBI, NIH
source_supported_en: Arrhythmia treatment may include medicines cardioversion catheter ablation pacemakers or implantable defibrillators.

source_title: Coronary Artery Bypass Grafting - Recovery from Surgery | NHLBI, NIH
source_supported_en: After CABG many people stay in the hospital about a week and need roughly 6 to 12 weeks to recover fully at home.

source_title: Coronary Artery Bypass Grafting - Recovery from Surgery | NHLBI, NIH
source_supported_en: Short-term side effects after bypass surgery may include chest pain near the incision constipation poor appetite mood changes sleep problems tiredness or swelling where the graft was taken.

source_title: Coronary Artery Bypass Grafting - Recovery from Surgery | NHLBI, NIH
source_supported_en: After CABG your doctor may prescribe medicines for pain blood pressure cholesterol blood clots or irregular rhythms.

source_title: Coronary Artery Bypass Grafting - Recovery from Surgery | NHLBI, NIH
source_supported_en: Cardiac rehabilitation can help you recover more safely by combining supervised exercise heart-healthy education and stress counseling.

source_title: Coronary Artery Bypass Grafting - Recovery from Surgery | NHLBI, NIH
source_supported_en: If you develop signs of a heart attack after bypass surgery call 9-1-1 right away because a blocked graft can stop blood flow to the heart.
